definitions.gloss: dismissal; removal from office; relief of duty
definitions.explanation: The act of removing someone from an official position or role. Used as a suru verb. A formal term used in corporate, political, and legal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{解任|かいにん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}→取締役会：28600_torishimariyakukai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{解任|かいにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: The board of directors decided to dismiss the manager.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}→発覚：07629_hakkaku⟧し、⟦{役員|やくいん}→役員：11329_yakuin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{解任|かいにん}⟦{動議|どうぎ}→動議：09762_dougi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|だ}された→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: After the scandal came to light, a motion to dismiss the executive was submitted.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal legal and business term. Unlike ⟦{解雇|かいこ}→解雇：04561_kaiko⟧ (firing an employee), {解任|かいにん} specifically refers to removing someone from an appointed position or office, such as a company officer, director, or official.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {解任|かいにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to dismiss from office)
- {解任|かいにん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be dismissed from office)
- {解任|かいにん}⟦{動議|どうぎ}→動議：09762_dougi⟧ (motion for dismissal)
- {解任|かいにん}⟦{決議|けつぎ}→決議：16467_ketsugi⟧ (resolution for dismissal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{解雇|かいこ}→解雇：04561_kaiko⟧: firing, dismissal — for regular employees
- ⟦{罷免|ひめん}→罷免：29397_himen⟧: removal from office — stronger, more formal, often for public officials
- ⟦{更迭|こうてつ}→更迭：07969_koutetsu⟧: replacement, reshuffle — replacing someone in a position
